I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I confirmed the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 10 June and said I won't do anything else.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't post a correction in #north-team. Their earlier message there still shows the wrong date. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the team if they want to fix it later.
